title.zh: 卷341 列傳一百二十八 庆桂 刘权之 戴衢亨 戴均元 托津 章煦 卢荫溥
title.en: Volume 341 Biographies 128: Qing Gui, Liu Quanzhi, Dai Quheng, Dai Junyuan, Tuo Jin, Zhang Xu, Lu Yinpu
title.raw: 卷341 列傳一百二十八 庆桂 刘权之 戴衢亨 戴均元 托津 章煦 卢荫溥

sentences.zh: 慶桂，字樹齋，章佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，大學士尹繼善子。

translations.literal: Qing Gui, courtesy name Shuzhai, of the Zhangjia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the son of Grand Secretary Yin Jishan.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Gui, whose courtesy name was Shuzhai, belonged to the Zhangjia clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was the son of Grand Secretary Yin Jishan.

sentences.zh: 以廕生授戶部員外郎，充軍機章京，超擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: By hereditary privilege he was appointed Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was promoted ahead of schedule to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege he received appointment as a vice director in the Ministry of Revenue, served on the Grand Council staff, and was then promoted ahead of schedule to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十二年，充庫倫辦事大臣，遷理籓院侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Qianlong he served as Commissioner at Khüree and was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 32 (1767) he served as commissioner at Khüree and was then transferred to vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，授軍機大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was appointed Grand Council minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 (1771) he was appointed a Grand Council minister.

sentences.zh: 居二載，出為伊犁參贊大臣，調塔爾巴哈台。

translations.literal: After two years he was sent out as Assistant Commissioner at Ili and transferred to Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: After two years on the council he was posted out as assistant commissioner at Ili and then transferred to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克巴布克詭稱阿布勒畢斯授為哈拉克齊，偕阿布勒畢斯之子博普來貢馬。

translations.literal: The Kazakh Babuk falsely claimed that Abulibis had appointed him as Harakchi and came with Abulibis's son Bopu to present tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Kazakh leader Babuk falsely claimed that Abulibis had named him Harakchi and arrived with Abulibis's son Bopu to present tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 慶桂以博普未至，巴布克狡詐不可信，斥之。

translations.literal: Qing Gui, on the grounds that Bopu had not come and that Babuk was deceitful and untrustworthy, rejected him.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Gui dismissed the claim because Bopu had not appeared and Babuk was too deceitful to be trusted.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其有識，曰：「尹繼善之子能如此，朕又得一能事大臣矣！」

translations.literal: The emperor praised his discernment, saying: "Yin Jishan's son can act thus— I have gained another capable minister!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his judgment, saying, "Yin Jishan's son can show such discernment—I have gained another capable minister!"

sentences.zh: 四十二年，授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 (1777) he was appointed vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 調烏里雅蘇台將軍，授正黃旗漢軍都統，以病回京。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be General at Uliastai, appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Plain Yellow Banner, and returned to the capital on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to general at Uliastai, appointed commander-in-chief of the Chinese Plain Yellow Banner, and returned to the capital because of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾年，授盛京將軍，調吉林，再調福州。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed General at Mukden, transferred to Jilin, and then transferred again to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed general at Mukden, then transferred to Jilin and afterward to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，入覲，授工部尚書，仍直軍機，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he came to court for an audience, was appointed Minister of Works, continued to serve on the Grand Council, and was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49 (1784) he came to court, was appointed minister of works, remained on the Grand Council, and was transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 逾年，署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: The following year he served as acting General of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he served as acting general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 時陝甘總督福康安赴阿克蘇安輯回眾，上以慶桂練邊事，命帶欽差關防，馳往甘肅，暫署總督。

translations.literal: At that time the Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Fuk'anggan had gone to Aksu to pacify returning populations; the emperor, considering Qing Gui experienced in frontier affairs, ordered him to carry the imperial commissioner seal, hasten to Gansu, and temporarily act as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Fuk'anggan had gone to Aksu to pacify returning populations; because Qing Gui was experienced in frontier affairs, the emperor ordered him to carry the imperial commissioner seal, hurry to Gansu, and serve temporarily as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋授塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Assistant Commissioner at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed assistant commissioner at Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，召授兵部尚書，歷署盛京、吉林、烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year he was summoned and appointed Minister of War, and successively served in acting capacity as General at Mukden, Jilin, and Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 51 (1786) he was recalled and appointed minister of war, and in succession acted as general at Mukden, Jilin, and Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，廓爾喀平，予議敘，圖形紫光閣，上親制贊。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, when Gurkha was pacified, he was granted merit evaluation, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and the emperor personally composed an encomium.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 (1792), after the Gurkha campaign was settled, he received merit evaluation, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and the emperor personally wrote his commendation.

sentences.zh: 兩淮鹽運使柴楨私挪課銀彌補浙江鹽道庫藏，命偕長麟赴浙按治，得巡撫福崧婪索侵蝕狀，讞上，福崧、楨俱伏法。

translations.literal: Chai Zhen, Salt Transport Commissioner of the Two Huai circuits, had privately diverted tax silver to cover deficits in the Zhejiang salt commissioner treasury; [Qing Gui] was ordered to go to Zhejiang with Chang Lin to investigate, obtained proof that Governor Fu Song had extorted and embezzled, submitted the case for judgment, and both Fu Song and Chai were executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Chai Zhen, salt transport commissioner of the Two Huai circuits, privately diverted tax silver to cover shortfalls in the Zhejiang salt treasury, Qing Gui was ordered to go to Zhejiang with Chang Lin to investigate. They uncovered Governor Fu Song's extortion and embezzlement, submitted the case for judgment, and both Fu Song and Chai were executed.

sentences.zh: 尋授荊州將軍。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed General at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed general at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 逾年，召授正紅旗蒙古都統，命勘南河高家堰石工。

translations.literal: The following year he was summoned and appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Mongol Plain Red Banner and ordered to inspect the stone works at Gaojia Embankment on the Southern Canal.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was recalled and appointed commander-in-chief of the Mongol Plain Red Banner, with orders to inspect the stone works at Gaojia Embankment on the Southern Canal.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，授刑部尚書、協辦大學士，复直軍機。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was appointed Minister of Punishments and Associate Grand Secretary and again served on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799) he was appointed minister of punishments and associate grand secretary and again took a seat on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 授內大臣，監修高宗實錄，加太子太保。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Household, supervised compilation of the Veritable Records of Gaozong, and was given the additional title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand minister of the imperial household, supervised compilation of the Veritable Records of the Qianlong reign, and received the additional title of junior tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 拜文淵閣大學士，總理刑部。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and placed in overall charge of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 裕陵奉安禮成，晉太子太傅，管理吏部、理籓院、戶部三庫事。

translations.literal: When the interment ceremony at Yuling was completed, he was promoted to Senior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and placed in charge of the Ministries of Personnel and Colonial Affairs and the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: After the interment ceremony at Yuling was completed, he was promoted to senior tutor to the heir apparent and given charge of the ministries of personnel and colonial affairs and the three revenue treasuries.

sentences.zh: 七年，三省教匪平，以贊畫功，予騎都尉世職，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the sect rebels in the three provinces were pacified, for his planning merit he was granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry fief and bestowed double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 (1802), after the sect rebels in the three provinces were pacified, he was rewarded for his planning with a hereditary commandant of cavalry fief and granted double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 九年，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Chief Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 9 (1804) he was appointed chief grand minister of the imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 高宗實錄成，賞紫韁，晉太子太師。

translations.literal: When the Veritable Records of Gaozong were completed, he was rewarded with a purple bridle and promoted to Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the Veritable Records of the Qianlong reign were completed, he was rewarded with a purple bridle and promoted to preceptor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年，扈蹕熱河，以腿疾免從行圍，予假回京。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he accompanied the imperial procession to Rehe; because of leg ailment he was excused from the hunting encampment and granted leave to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 16 (1811) he accompanied the court to Rehe; because of a leg ailment he was excused from the hunting encampment and granted leave to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十七年，晉太保。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 17 (1812) he was promoted to grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 上念其年老，罷直軍機處，仍授內大臣。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful of his advanced age, removed him from the Grand Council but still appointed him Grand Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of his advanced age, the emperor removed him from the Grand Council but still appointed him grand minister of the imperial household.

sentences.zh: 慶桂性和平，居樞廷數十年，初無過失，舉趾不離跬寸，時咸稱其風度。

translations.literal: Qing Gui's nature was mild and peaceful; he sat in the Grand Council for several decades without a single fault, and his bearing never strayed a foot from propriety—at the time all praised his demeanor.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Gui was mild and even-tempered; he served on the Grand Council for decades without a single lapse, and his conduct never strayed from propriety—contemporaries all praised his bearing.

sentences.zh: 逾年，命以原品休致，給予全俸。

translations.literal: The following year he was ordered to retire at his original rank and granted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was ordered to retire at his original rank with full salary.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒，諡文恪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenge.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 21 (1816) he died and was posthumously titled Wenge.

sentences.zh: 劉權之，字云房，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: Liu Quanzhi, courtesy name Yunfang, was a native of Changsha in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Quanzhi, whose courtesy name was Yunfang, came from Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，累擢司經局洗馬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and was repeatedly promoted to Reader in the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25 (1760) he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and rose in succession to reader in the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，督安徽學政。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he served as Educational Commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 (1778) he served as educational commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 預修四庫全書，在事最久，及總目提要告成，以勞擢侍講。

translations.literal: He took part in compiling the Complete Library in Four Branches, served on the project longer than anyone else, and when the General Catalogue and Abstracts were completed was promoted to Reader for his labor.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in compiling the Complete Library in Four Branches and served on the project longer than anyone else; when the General Catalogue and Abstracts were finished, he was promoted to reader in recognition of his labor.

sentences.zh: 五十年，大考二等。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he ranked second class in the grand evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 (1785) he ranked second class in the grand evaluation.

sentences.zh: 逾年，擢大理寺卿，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: The following year he was promoted to President of the Court of Judicial Review and transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was promoted to president of the Court of Judicial Review and transferred to left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「大挑舉人多夤緣，請於事前一日簡派王大臣，聞命即宿朝房，以杜弊竇。」

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "Many selected graduates in the great selection secure posts through connections; I request that one day beforehand princes and grand ministers be specially assigned, and that upon receiving the order they lodge overnight in the court offices to block abuses."
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he wrote that many graduates selected in the great civil-service placement secured posts through connections, and asked that princes and grand ministers be specially assigned one day beforehand and lodge overnight in the court offices upon receiving orders, so as to block abuses.

sentences.zh: 於是命在午門蒞事，御史監視，護軍巡察，步軍、五城一體嚴查，著為令。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was ordered that the affair be conducted at the Meridian Gate with censors supervising, guards patrolling, and the infantry and Five Cities jointly conducting strict inspection—established as a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the court ordered that the selection be conducted at the Meridian Gate with censors supervising, guards patrolling, and the infantry and Five Cities conducting joint strict inspection—this became a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 尋督山東學政。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he served as Educational Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as educational commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，擢禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 56 (1791) he was promoted to vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 六十年，典江南鄉試，留學政。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination and remained as Educational Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 60 (1795) he presided over the Jiangnan provincial examination and remained as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 (1797) he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢左都御史，典會試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and presided over the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799) he was promoted to left censor-in-chief and presided over the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「買補倉穀，地方官奉行不善，在本境採買，不論市價長賤，發銀四五錢。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "In purchasing grain to replenish granaries, local officials carry out the policy poorly: they procure within their own jurisdiction, pay four or five cash in silver regardless of whether market prices are high or low,
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he reported that when officials purchased grain to replenish granaries, local magistrates carried out the policy badly: they procured within their own jurisdictions and paid four or five cash in silver regardless of whether market prices were high or low,

sentences.zh: 花戶不原納穀，惟求繳還原銀，加倍交價。

translations.literal: grain contractors are unwilling to deliver grain and only seek to return the original silver at double the price,
translations.idiomatic: grain contractors refused to deliver grain and only sought to return the original silver at double the price,

sentences.zh: 富戶賄吏飛灑零戶，轉得少派。

translations.literal: wealthy households bribe clerks to shift assessments onto scattered households and thereby receive lighter levies,
translations.idiomatic: wealthy households bribed clerks to shift assessments onto scattered households and thereby received lighter levies,

sentences.zh: 善良貧民深受其累。

translations.literal: and honest poor commoners suffer deeply under the burden.
translations.idiomatic: while honest poor commoners bore the heaviest burden.

sentences.zh: 官以折價入己，仍無存米。

translations.literal: Officials pocket the discounted payments for themselves, and still no grain is stored.
translations.idiomatic: Officials pocketed the discounted payments for themselves, and still no grain was stored.

sentences.zh: 遇協濟鄰省，令米商倉猝購辦，發價剋扣，起運勒掯。

translations.literal: When aid to neighboring provinces is required, grain merchants are ordered to purchase hastily; disbursements are withheld and transport is extorted at shipment.
translations.idiomatic: When aid to neighboring provinces was required, grain merchants were ordered to purchase hastily; disbursements were withheld and transport was extorted at shipment.

sentences.zh: 請飭遇應買補，向豐稔鄰縣公平採辦，不得於本縣苛派，嚴禁胥吏舞弊。」

translations.literal: I request that whenever replenishment purchases are required, procurement be conducted fairly in neighboring counties with good harvests, that harsh levies within one's own county be forbidden, and that clerk malfeasance be strictly prohibited."
translations.idiomatic: He asked that whenever replenishment purchases were required, procurement be conducted fairly in neighboring counties with good harvests, that harsh levies within one's own county be forbidden, and that clerk malfeasance be strictly prohibited."

sentences.zh: 又言：「社倉大半藉端挪移，管理首事與胥吏從中侵盜，至歉歲顆粒無存，以致殷實之戶不樂捐輸，老成之士不原承辦，請一律查禁。」

translations.literal: He also stated: "Most community granaries are largely diverted under pretexts; managing heads and clerks embezzle in the middle, so that in years of scarcity not a grain remains, with the result that prosperous households are unwilling to contribute and seasoned elders are unwilling to undertake management—I request that all such cases be investigated and prohibited."
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that most community granaries were largely diverted under pretexts, that managing heads and clerks embezzled in the process, so that in years of scarcity not a grain remained, with the result that prosperous households were unwilling to contribute and seasoned elders were unwilling to manage them, and asked that all such cases be investigated and prohibited.

sentences.zh: 詔韙之，飭各直省嚴禁，民得免累，湖、​​湘間尤稱頌焉。

translations.literal: An edict approved his proposals and ordered all provinces to enforce strict prohibition; the people were spared the burden, and between Hunan and Hubei he was especially praised.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his proposals and ordered all provinces to enforce strict prohibition; the people were spared the burden, and he was especially praised in Hunan and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 編修洪亮吉上書王大臣言事戇直，成親王徑以上達，權之與硃珪未即呈奏，有旨詰問，自請嚴議。

translations.literal: Compiler Hong Liangji submitted a memorial to princes and grand ministers that was blunt in its remonstrance; the Prince of Cheng reported it directly to the throne; Quanzhi and Zhu Gui did not present it immediately; an edict demanded explanation, and he requested severe punishment for himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Compiler Hong Liangji submitted a blunt memorial to princes and grand ministers, the Prince of Cheng reported it directly to the throne; Quanzhi and Zhu Gui had not presented it immediately; the emperor demanded an explanation, and Quanzhi asked that he himself be severely punished.

sentences.zh: 上以權之人品端正，平時陳奏不欺，寬其處分。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Quanzhi's upright character and his habit of truthful memorials, lightened his punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, considering Quanzhi's upright character and his habit of truthful memorials, lightened his punishment.

sentences.zh: 尋遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 五年，典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 (1800) he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 六年，命為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Grand Council minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6 (1801) he was appointed a Grand Council minister.

sentences.zh: 越一歲，會川、楚、陝教匪戡定，權之入直未久，上嘉其素日陳奏時有所見，疊予褒敘。

translations.literal: After one year, when the sect rebels in Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi were pacified, Quanzhi had not long been on the council; the emperor praised his memorials as often insightful and repeatedly granted him commendation and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, when the sect rebels in Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi were pacified, Quanzhi had not long been on the council; the emperor praised his memorials as often insightful and repeatedly granted him commendation and promotion.

sentences.zh: 在吏部久，疏通淹滯，銓政號平。

translations.literal: He served long in the Ministry of Personnel, cleared backlogs, and his appointments were known as fair.
translations.idiomatic: He served long in the Ministry of Personnel, cleared backlogs, and his appointments were known as fair.

sentences.zh: 九年，失察書吏虛選舞弊，因兼直樞廷，薄譴之，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he failed to detect clerks' fraud in fictitious selections; because he also served on the Grand Council he received a light reprimand and was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 9 (1804) he failed to detect clerks' fraud in fictitious selections; because he also served on the Grand Council he received a light reprimand and was transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十年，以禮部尚書、協辦大學士，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he served as Minister of Rites and Associate Grand Secretary and was given the additional title of Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10 (1805) he served as minister of rites and associate grand secretary and received the additional title of junior guardian to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 軍機章京、中書袁煦者，故大學士紀昀女夫也，入直已邀恩敘，權之於昀有舊恩，至是復欲以袁煦列薦。

translations.literal: Grand Council clerk and Secretariat drafter Yuan Xu was the son-in-law of the late Grand Secretary Ji Yun; upon entering the council he had already sought preferential promotion; Quanzhi owed Yun an old debt of gratitude and now again wished to recommend Yuan Xu for listing.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Council clerk and secretariat drafter Yuan Xu was the son-in-law of the late Grand Secretary Ji Yun; upon entering the council he had already sought preferential promotion; Quanzhi owed Yun an old debt of gratitude and now again wished to recommend Yuan Xu for preferment.

sentences.zh: 同官英和議不合，已中止，英和密請晏見，面劾權之瞻徇。

translations.literal: His colleague Ying He disagreed and the matter had already been stopped; Ying He secretly requested an informal audience and in person impeached Quanzhi for favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: His colleague Ying He disagreed and the matter had already been stopped; Ying He secretly requested an informal audience and in person impeached Quanzhi for favoritism.

sentences.zh: 上不悅，兩人同罷直，下廷議革職，念權之前勞，降編修。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased; both men were removed from the council; the court deliberated dismissal from office, but mindful of Quanzhi's earlier service, he was demoted to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased; both men were removed from the council; the court deliberated dismissal from office, but mindful of Quanzhi's earlier service, he was demoted to compiler.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢侍讀，遷光祿寺卿，歷遷兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Reader, transferred to President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and successively promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to reader, transferred to president of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and in succession rose to minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十五年，協辦大學士，典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as Associate Grand Secretary and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 15 (1810) he served as associate grand secretary and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 是年，帝以秋狝幸熱河，明年，幸五台，並命留京辦事，拜體仁閣大學士，管理工部，復加太子少保。

translations.literal: That year the emperor went on the autumn hunt to Rehe; the next year he visited Wutai; both times Quanzhi was ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs, was appointed Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Works, and again given the additional title of Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor went on the autumn hunt to Rehe; the next year he visited Wutai; both times Quanzhi was ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs, was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Works, and again received the additional title of junior guardian to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十八年，目疾乞假，遣御醫診視。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he requested leave on account of eye ailment, and an imperial physician was sent to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 18 (1813) he requested leave because of an eye ailment, and an imperial physician was sent to examine him.

sentences.zh: 會逆匪林清為變，事定，朝臣衰病者多罷退，詔以原品休致回籍，給半俸。

translations.literal: When the rebel Lin Qing raised a disturbance and the affair was settled, many court officials enfeebled by age and illness were dismissed; an edict ordered him to retire at his original rank and return to his native place with half salary.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel Lin Qing raised a disturbance and the affair was settled, many aged and infirm court officials were dismissed; an edict ordered Quanzhi to retire at his original rank and return home with half salary.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，卒於家，年八十，諡文恪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he died at home at the age of eighty and was given the posthumous title Wenge.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 23 (1818) he died at home at the age of eighty and was posthumously titled Wenge.

sentences.zh: 戴衢亨，字蓮士，江西大庾人。

translations.literal: Dai Quheng, courtesy name Lianshi, was a native of Dayu in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Quheng, whose courtesy name was Lianshi, came from Dayu in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 父第元，由編修官太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: His father Di Yuan rose from compiler to President of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: His father Di Yuan rose from compiler to president of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 衢亨年十七，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: Quheng at seventeen passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Quheng passed the provincial examination at the age of seventeen.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，召試，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong he was summoned for examination, appointed Secretariat drafter in the Grand Secretariat, and served as Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 (1776) he was summoned for examination, appointed a grand secretariat drafter, and served on the Grand Council staff.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，成一甲一名進士，授翰林院修撰，典試湖北。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year he placed first in the first class of the metropolitan graduates, was appointed Hanlin Compiler, and presided over the examination in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 (1778) he placed first in the first class of metropolitan graduates, was appointed Hanlin compiler, and presided over the examination in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 叔父均元、兄心亨並居館職，迭任文衡，稱「西江四戴」。

translations.literal: His uncle Junyuan and elder brother Xinheng both held academy posts and successively served as literary examiners—they were called "the Four Dai of the Western River."
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Junyuan and elder brother Xinheng both held academy posts and in turn served as literary examiners—they were known as "the Four Dai of the Western River."

sentences.zh: 尋命仍直軍機。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to resume service on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to resume service on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 秋狝扈蹕，射狍以獻，高宗賜詩美之。

translations.literal: On the autumn hunt he accompanied the imperial procession, shot a roe deer and presented it, and Gaozong bestowed a poem in praise.
translations.idiomatic: On the autumn hunt he accompanied the imperial procession, shot a roe deer and presented it, and the Qianlong Emperor bestowed a poem in praise.

sentences.zh: 累典江南、湖南鄉試，督山西、廣東學政，歷遷侍講學士。

translations.literal: He repeatedly presided over the Jiangnan and Hunan provincial examinations, served as Educational Commissioner of Shanxi and Guangdong, and was successively promoted to Reader in the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly presided over the Jiangnan and Hunan provincial examinations, served as educational commissioner of Shanxi and Guangdong, and rose in succession to Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，授受禮成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the succession ceremony was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 (1796) the succession ceremony was completed.

sentences.zh: 凡大典撰擬文字，皆出其手。

translations.literal: All drafting for great state ceremonies came from his hand.
translations.idiomatic: All drafting for major state ceremonies came from his hand.

sentences.zh: 二年，命隨軍機大臣學習行走，以秩卑，特加三品卿銜。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ordered to study and serve alongside Grand Council ministers; because his rank was low, he was specially given the additional title of third-rank academician.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 (1797) he was ordered to study and serve alongside Grand Council ministers; because his rank was low, he was specially given the additional title of third-rank academician.

sentences.zh: 累遷禮部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to vice minister of rites and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 四年，仁宗始親政。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Jiaqing Emperor began to rule in person.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799) the Jiaqing Emperor began to rule in person.

sentences.zh: 衢亨以病乞假；

translations.literal: Quheng requested leave on account of illness;
translations.idiomatic: Quheng requested leave because of illness;

sentences.zh: 假滿，兼署吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: when leave ended he concurrently served as acting Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: when his leave ended he concurrently served as acting vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢兵部尚書，兼管順天府尹、戶部三庫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Minister of War and concurrently managed the Shuntian Intendant and the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6 (1801) he was promoted to minister of war and concurrently managed the Shuntian intendant and the three revenue treasuries.

sentences.zh: 川、楚、陝教匪以次削平，以贊畫功，屢荷優褒。

translations.literal: The sect rebels in Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi were pacified in succession; for his planning merit he repeatedly received exceptional commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The sect rebels in Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi were pacified in succession; for his planning merit he repeatedly received exceptional commendation.

sentences.zh: 七年，大功戡定，詔嘉其知無不言，言無不盡，克盡忠悃，加太子少保，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the great campaign was settled, an edict praised him for speaking without reserve and fulfilling loyal devotion, granted him the additional title of Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent, and bestowed a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain fief.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 (1802), when the great campaign was settled, an edict praised him for speaking without reserve and fulfilling loyal devotion, granted him the additional title of junior guardian to the heir apparent, and bestowed a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain fief.

sentences.zh: 九年，失察順天府書吏盜印，罷兼尹。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he failed to detect Shuntian clerks' theft of seals and was removed from the concurrent intendant post.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 9 (1804) he failed to detect Shuntian clerks' theft of seals and was removed from the concurrent intendant post.

sentences.zh: 十年，調戶部，兼直南書房，典會試。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, concurrently served in the Southern Studios, and presided over the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10 (1805) he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, concurrently served in the Southern Studios, and presided over the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 十二年，協辦大學士，兼翰林院掌院學士，典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he served as Associate Grand Secretary and concurrently as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 12 (1807) he served as associate grand secretary and concurrently as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕大學士長麟視南河。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went with Grand Secretary Chang Lin to inspect the Southern Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13 (1808) he went with Grand Secretary Chang Lin to inspect the Southern Canal.

sentences.zh: 時河事日敝，帝銳意整頓，中外臣工議不一，特命查勘籌議。

translations.literal: At that time river affairs grew daily worse; the emperor was determined to put them in order, but court and provincial officials disagreed, and he specially ordered investigation and planning.
translations.idiomatic: At that time river affairs were growing daily worse; the emperor was determined to put them in order, but court and provincial officials disagreed, and he specially ordered investigation and planning.

sentences.zh: 衢亨叔均元方以總河謝病家居，許便道省視，遂與長麟三疏陳治河要義，斟酌緩急，停修毛城鋪滾水壩，复天然閘東山罅閘壩，以減黃濟運；

translations.literal: Quheng's uncle Junyuan had just resigned as Director-General of Rivers on account of illness and was at home; permission was granted to visit him by the way; he and Chang Lin then submitted three memorials setting forth the essentials of river control, weighing urgency, halting repairs to the overflow dam at Maochengpu, restoring the sluice dams at the Natural Gate and Dongshanxia to reduce Yellow River water entering the transport canal;
translations.idiomatic: Quheng's uncle Junyuan had just resigned as director-general of rivers because of illness and was at home; permission was granted to visit him along the way; he and Chang Lin then submitted three memorials setting forth the essentials of river control, weighing urgency, halting repairs to the overflow dam at Maochengpu, and restoring the sluice dams at the Natural Gate and Dongshanxia to reduce Yellow River water entering the transport canal;

sentences.zh: 於王營減壩西，增築滾壩、石壩，普培沿河大堤，以淮、揚境內為尤急。

translations.literal: west of the reduction dam at Wangying, additional overflow and stone dams were to be built, and the great embankments along the river were to be broadly reinforced, with the Huai-Yang region regarded as most urgent.
translations.idiomatic: west of the reduction dam at Wangying they proposed building additional overflow and stone dams and broadly reinforcing the great embankments along the river, with the Huai-Yang region regarded as most urgent.

sentences.zh: 雲梯關外八灘以上，接築雁翅堤以束水勢。

translations.literal: Above the eight shoals outside Yunti Pass, wing-shaped embankments were to be joined and built to restrain the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: Above the eight shoals outside Yunti Pass they proposed joining and building wing-shaped embankments to restrain the water's force.

sentences.zh: 高堰、山盱石堤加築後戧土坡，為暫救目前之計，徐辦碎石坦坡以護石工。

translations.literal: At Gaoyan and Shanxu stone embankments, rear earthen slopes were to be added as a temporary measure for the present emergency, with gravel slopes to be undertaken gradually to protect the stone works.
translations.idiomatic: At the Gaoyan and Shanxu stone embankments they proposed adding rear earthen slopes as a temporary measure, with gravel slopes to be undertaken gradually to protect the stone works.

sentences.zh: 智、禮二壩加高石基四尺，以製宣洩。

translations.literal: The Zhi and Li dams were to have their stone foundations raised four feet to regulate discharge.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhi and Li dams were to have their stone foundations raised four feet to regulate discharge.

sentences.zh: 疏上，帝深韙之，命嗣後考覈河工以為標準。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor strongly approved it and ordered that hereafter river works be evaluated by this standard.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor strongly approved it and ordered that hereafter river works be evaluated by this standard.

sentences.zh: 十四年，萬壽慶典，晉太子少師。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, at the longevity celebration, he was promoted to Junior Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 14 (1809), at the longevity celebration, he was promoted to junior preceptor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 衢亨性清通，無聲色之好。

translations.literal: Quheng's nature was clear and penetrating, without fondness for music or women.
translations.idiomatic: Quheng was clear-minded and penetrating, without fondness for music or women.

sentences.zh: 朝退延接士大夫，言人人殊，不置可否，而朝廷設施，有見之數月數年之後者。

translations.literal: After court he received scholars and officials; each spoke differently, and he neither affirmed nor denied—yet court measures were sometimes seen to bear fruit months or years later.
translations.idiomatic: After court he received scholars and officials; each spoke differently, and he neither affirmed nor denied—yet court measures were sometimes seen to bear fruit months or years later.

sentences.zh: 柄政既久，仁宗推心任之。

translations.literal: Having held power long, the Jiaqing Emperor entrusted him with complete confidence.
translations.idiomatic: Having held power for a long time, the Jiaqing Emperor entrusted him with complete confidence.

sentences.zh: 給事中花傑疏論長蘆欠課，衢亨方筦戶部，議下鹽政覈辦。

translations.literal: Censor Hua Jie memorialized on arrears in the Changlu salt tax; Quheng was then managing the Ministry of Revenue, and the matter was referred to the salt administration for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hua Jie memorialized on arrears in the Changlu salt tax; Quheng was then managing the Ministry of Revenue, and the matter was referred to the salt administration for investigation.

sentences.zh: 傑乃劾衢亨與鹽商查有圻姻親，餽送往來，助營第宅，不免徇庇；

translations.literal: Jie then impeached Quheng for kinship by marriage with the salt merchant Zha Youqi, gifts exchanged back and forth, assistance in building a residence, and inevitable favoritism;
translations.idiomatic: Jie then impeached Quheng for kinship by marriage with the salt merchant Zha Youqi, for gifts exchanged back and forth and assistance in building a residence, and for inevitable favoritism;

sentences.zh: 又廷試閱卷，援引洪瑩為一甲一名，有交通情狀；

translations.literal: also in reading palace examination papers he had advanced Hong Ying to first place in the first class, showing signs of collusion;
translations.idiomatic: also in reading palace examination papers he had advanced Hong Ying to first place in the first class, showing signs of collusion;

sentences.zh: 薦週系英、王以銜、席煜、姚元之入南書房，與英和陰附結黨。

translations.literal: and for recommending Zhou Xiying, Wang Yixian, Xi Yu, and Yao Yuanzhi to the Southern Studios and secretly forming a faction with Ying He.
translations.idiomatic: and for recommending Zhou Xiying, Wang Yixian, Xi Yu, and Yao Yuanzhi to the Southern Studios and secretly forming a faction with Ying He.

sentences.zh: 衢亨疏辨，下廷臣察詢，命二阿哥監視洪瑩覆寫試策，無誤，迭詔為衢亨湔雪；

translations.literal: Quheng submitted a defense; the court ministers were ordered to investigate; the Second Imperial Son was ordered to supervise Hong Ying in rewriting his examination paper—no error was found—and repeated edicts cleared Quheng;
translations.idiomatic: Quheng submitted a defense; the court ministers were ordered to investigate; the second imperial son was ordered to supervise Hong Ying in rewriting his examination paper—no error was found—and repeated edicts cleared Quheng;

sentences.zh: 惟斥其令部員劉承澍在園寓具稿，致招物議，予薄譴，鐫級留任；

translations.literal: only rebuking him for having ministry staff member Liu Chengshu draft documents at his garden residence, which drew public criticism, granting a light reprimand and demotion in rank while retaining his post;
translations.idiomatic: only rebuking him for having ministry staff member Liu Chengshu draft documents at his garden residence, which drew public criticism, granting a light reprimand and demotion in rank while retaining his post;

sentences.zh: 坐傑污衊，承澍漏洩，降黜有差。

translations.literal: Jie was punished for slander, and Chengshu for leaking information, with differing demotions.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was punished for slander, and Chengshu for leaking information, with differing demotions.

sentences.zh: 因調衢亨工部。

translations.literal: Quheng was accordingly transferred to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Quheng was accordingly transferred to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 復以凡部臣有直軍機者，遇交議，同官每向探意旨，事後輒相推諉，特諭申儆焉。

translations.literal: Moreover, because any ministry official who served on the Grand Council, when matters were under joint deliberation, had colleagues probe his intentions and afterward shift blame, a special edict warned them.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because ministry officials who served on the Grand Council had colleagues probe their intentions during joint deliberation and afterward shift blame, a special edict warned them.

sentences.zh: 十五年，拜體仁閣大學士，管理工部，兼掌翰林院如故。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Works, and continued to head the Hanlin Academy as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 15 (1810) he was appointed grand secretary of the Tiren Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Works, and continued to head the Hanlin Academy as before.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，扈蹕五台，至正定病，先回京。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year he accompanied the imperial procession to Wutai; at Zhengding he fell ill and returned to the capital ahead of the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 16 (1811) he accompanied the imperial procession to Wutai; at Zhengding he fell ill and returned to the capital ahead of the court.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年五十有七。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he died at the age of fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at the age of fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 溫詔優恤，稱其謹飭清慎，實為國家得力大臣，親臨賜奠，贈太子太師，入祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: A warm edict granted exceptional condolence, praising his scrupulous integrity as a truly effective minister of state; the emperor personally bestowed funeral offerings, granted him posthumous rank as Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthies, and gave the posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: A warm edict granted exceptional condolence, praising his scrupulous integrity as a truly effective minister of state; the emperor personally bestowed funeral offerings, granted him posthumous rank as grand preceptor to the heir apparent, enshrined him in the Shrine of Worthies, and gave the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 子嘉端，年甫十一，賜舉人，襲雲騎尉。

translations.literal: His son Jiaduan, only eleven years old, was granted the rank of provincial graduate and inherited the Cloud Cavalry Captain fief.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jiaduan, only eleven years old, was granted the rank of provincial graduate and inherited the Cloud Cavalry Captain fief.

sentences.zh: 戴均元，字修原。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan, courtesy name Xiuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan, whose courtesy name was Xiuyuan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year of Qianlong he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 40 (1775) he passed the metropolitan examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 遷御史，迭典江南、湖北鄉試，督四川、安徽學政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to censor, repeatedly presided over the Jiangnan and Hubei provincial examinations, and served as Educational Commissioner of Sichuan and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor, repeatedly presided over the Jiangnan and Hubei provincial examinations, and served as educational commissioner of Sichuan and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，由安徽任滿還京，兄子衢亨先已超授軍機大臣，故事，大臣親屬任科道者，對品迴避，均元例改六部員外郎，特命以鴻臚寺少卿候補。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, when he returned to the capital after completing his term in Anhui, his nephew Quheng had already been promoted ahead of schedule to Grand Council minister; by precedent, when a grand minister's relative held a censorial post, he was to avoid the corresponding rank—Junyuan was normally to be transferred to vice director in one of the Six Ministries, but was specially ordered to await appointment as Vice President of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 (1798), when he returned to the capital after completing his term in Anhui, his nephew Quheng had already been promoted ahead of schedule to Grand Council minister; by precedent, when a grand minister's relative held a censorial post, he was to avoid the corresponding rank—Junyuan was normally to be transferred to vice director in one of the Six Ministries, but was specially ordered to await appointment as vice president of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 累擢工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 八年，偕侍郎貢楚克扎布察視張秋運河及衡家樓決口工程。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he went with Vice Minister Gunchukezhabu to inspect the Zhangqiu Canal and the breach works at Hengjialou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8 (1803) he went with Vice Minister Gunchukezhabu to inspect the Zhangqiu Canal and the breach works at Hengjialou.

sentences.zh: 歷戶部、吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as Vice Minister of Revenue and Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as vice minister of revenue and vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 十年，南河黃流奪運，高堰石工壞，特命馳視籌度。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Yellow River seized the transport canal on the Southern Rivers and the Gaoyan stone works were ruined; he was specially ordered to hurry there to inspect and plan.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10 (1805) the Yellow River seized the transport canal on the Southern Rivers and the Gaoyan stone works were ruined; he was specially ordered to hurry there to inspect and plan.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔以湖、河異漲，高堰堤工賴先築子堰，保衛無虞，清水暢注，河口積淤刷滌，已復三分入運、七分入黃舊制，為河事一大轉機，嘉均元盡心宣防，特復正、副總河舊制，授南河總督，以舊督徐端副之。

translations.literal: The next year an edict stated that because lake and river rose at different times, the Gaoyan embankment works relied on the previously built subsidiary embankment for protection without mishap, clear water flowed freely, accumulated silt at the estuary was scoured away, and the old ratio of three-tenths into the canal and seven-tenths into the Yellow River was restored—a great turning point in river affairs; Junyuan's devoted flood control was praised, the former system of director-general and deputy director-general was specially restored, he was appointed Governor-General of the Southern Rivers, with the former governor Xu Duan as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: The next year an edict stated that because lake and river rose at different times, the Gaoyan embankment works relied on the previously built subsidiary embankment for protection without mishap, clear water flowed freely, accumulated silt at the estuary was scoured away, and the old ratio of three-tenths into the canal and seven-tenths into the Yellow River was restored—a great turning point in river affairs; Junyuan's devoted flood control was praised, the former system of director-general and deputy director-general was specially restored, he was appointed governor-general of the Southern Rivers, with the former governor Xu Duan as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 在任三年，堵合黃河周家堡、郭家坊、王營減壩、陳家浦，及運河二堡、壯原墩，築高堰義字壩，拆修惠濟閘，以減壩合龍，加太子少保。

translations.literal: During three years in office he closed breaches in the Yellow River at Zhoujiabao, Guojiafang, Wangying reduction dam, and Chenjiapu, and on the canal at Erbiao and Zhuangyuandun, built the Yizi dam at Gaoyan, dismantled and repaired the Huiji Sluice, and when the reduction dam was joined received the additional title of Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: During three years in office he closed breaches in the Yellow River at Zhoujiabao, Guojiafang, the Wangying reduction dam, and Chenjiapu, and on the canal at Erbiao and Zhuangyuandun, built the Yizi dam at Gaoyan, dismantled and repaired the Huiji Sluice, and when the reduction dam was joined received the additional title of junior guardian to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 病，乞解任，尋愈，因事降三品京堂，授左副都御史，督順天學政。

translations.literal: He fell ill and requested release from office; he soon recovered, but because of an affair was demoted to third-rank metropolitan official, appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and made Educational Commissioner of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill and requested release from office; he soon recovered, but because of an affair was demoted to third-rank metropolitan official, appointed left vice censor-in-chief, and made educational commissioner of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Granary Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to vice minister of the granary administration.

sentences.zh: 十八年秋，河決睢州，出為東河總督。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighteenth year the river breached at Suizhou; he was sent out as Governor-General of the Eastern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jiaqing 18 (1813) the river breached at Suizhou; he was sent out as governor-general of the Eastern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 詔以均元曾任南河，許便宜調用工員，責速堵合。

translations.literal: An edict stated that because Junyuan had formerly served on the Southern Rivers, he was permitted to deploy laborers as circumstances required and charged to close the breach swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that because Junyuan had formerly served on the Southern Rivers, he was permitted to deploy laborers as circumstances required and charged to close the breach swiftly.

sentences.zh: 明年春，以吏部侍郎內召，途次擢左都御史。

translations.literal: The next spring he was recalled to the capital as Vice Minister of Personnel and en route was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring he was recalled to the capital as vice minister of personnel and en route was promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋遷禮部尚書，調吏部。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was transferred to Minister of Rites and then to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to minister of rites and then to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he served as Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 20 (1815) he served as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 逾年，授軍機大臣，充上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed Grand Council minister and served as Chief Tutor in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed a Grand Council minister and served as chief tutor in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，拜文淵閣大學士，晉太子太保，管理刑部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, promoted to Senior Guardian to the Heir Apparent, and placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 23 (1818) he was appointed grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, promoted to senior guardian to the heir apparent, and placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，河決武陟馬營壩，自秋徂冬尚未啟工，奉命馳視，還報購料未集，詔嚴斥在事諸臣以示儆。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the river breached at the Maying dam in Wuzhi; from autumn to winter work had not yet begun; he was ordered to hurry there to inspect; on return he reported that materials had not been assembled; an edict sternly rebuked the officials involved as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 24 (1819) the river breached at the Maying dam in Wuzhi; from autumn to winter work had not yet begun; he was ordered to hurry there to inspect; on return he reported that materials had not been assembled; an edict sternly rebuked the officials involved as a warning.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，扈從熱河，甫駐蹕，帝不豫，鄉夕大漸。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year he accompanied the court to Rehe; the emperor had just halted the procession when he fell ill and by evening grew gravely worse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Jiaqing 25 (1820) he accompanied the court to Rehe; the emperor had just halted the procession when he fell ill and by evening grew gravely worse.

sentences.zh: 均元與大學士托津督內侍檢禦篋，得小金盒，啟鐍，宣示御書立宣宗為皇太子，奉嗣尊位，然後發喪。

translations.literal: Junyuan and Grand Secretary Tuo Jin supervised the eunuchs in inspecting the imperial casket, obtained a small gold box, opened the lock, proclaimed the imperial writing establishing the Xuanzong Emperor as heir apparent, installed him on the succession throne, and only then announced the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Junyuan and Grand Secretary Tuo Jin supervised the eunuchs in inspecting the imperial casket, obtained a small gold box, opened the lock, proclaimed the imperial writing establishing the Xuanzong Emperor as heir apparent, installed him on the succession throne, and only then announced the mourning.

sentences.zh: 洎還京，因撰擬遺詔有「高宗降生於避暑山莊」之語，誤引御製詩注，樞臣皆被譴鐫級，均元與托津並罷直。

translations.literal: When they returned to the capital, because the drafted testamentary edict contained the phrase "Gaozong was born at the Mountain Villa for Escaping Summer" and mistakenly cited an annotation to an imperial poem, the Grand Council ministers were all rebuked and demoted in rank; Junyuan and Tuo Jin were both removed from the council.
translations.idiomatic: When they returned to the capital, because the drafted testamentary edict contained the phrase "Gaozong was born at the Mountain Villa for Escaping Summer" and mistakenly cited an annotation to an imperial poem, the Grand Council ministers were all rebuked and demoted in rank; Junyuan and Tuo Jin were both removed from the council.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，裕陵隆恩殿柱蠹朽，距修建甫二十年，承辦工員俱獲罪。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang the pillars of the Long'en Hall at Yuling were found worm-eaten; only twenty years had passed since construction, and all the contracting officials were punished.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 (1822) the pillars of the Long'en Hall at Yuling were found worm-eaten; only twenty years had passed since construction, and all the contracting officials were punished.

sentences.zh: 均元以在事未久，從寬罷管部務，奪宮銜，責同賠修，工畢復之。

translations.literal: Because Junyuan had not long been involved in the matter, he was leniently relieved of ministry duties, stripped of court rank, charged to share in compensation for repairs, and restored when the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Because Junyuan had not long been involved in the matter, he was leniently relieved of ministry duties, stripped of court rank, charged to share in compensation for repairs, and restored when the work was completed.

sentences.zh: 漳水北徙，命均元馳視。

translations.literal: When the Zhang River shifted northward, Junyuan was ordered to hurry there to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhang River shifted northward, Junyuan was ordered to hurry there to inspect.

sentences.zh: 次年，因漳水下流潰直隸元城紅花堤，塞之則元城北境水無所洩，不塞則山東館陶受其害，復命均元往視。

translations.literal: The next year, because the lower Zhang breached the Honghua embankment in Yuancheng, Zhili—if sealed, the northern Yuancheng region would have no outlet for water; if not sealed, Guantao in Shandong would suffer harm—Junyuan was again ordered to go and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, because the lower Zhang breached the Honghua embankment in Yuancheng, Zhili—if sealed, the northern Yuancheng region would have no outlet for water; if not sealed, Guantao in Shandong would suffer harm—Junyuan was again ordered to go and inspect.

sentences.zh: 議展寬舊有引河，俾積水穿堤入衛水，別就堤下新刷水溝挑成河道，分流洩入館陶境，築堤防溢。

translations.literal: It was proposed to widen the old diversion channel so accumulated water could pass through the embankment into the Wei River, and separately to excavate a channel from the newly scoured ditch below the embankment to divert water into Guantao territory, with embankments built to prevent overflow.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed widening the old diversion channel so accumulated water could pass through the embankment into the Wei River, and separately excavating a channel from the newly scoured ditch below the embankment to divert water into Guantao territory, with embankments built to prevent overflow.

sentences.zh: 复偕巡撫程祖洛勘上游，議：「漳水自乾隆五十一年南徙合洹水後，衛水為所格阻，頻年沖決，由於合則為患。

translations.literal: He again went with Governor Cheng Zuluo to survey the upper reaches and proposed: "Since the Zhang shifted south in the fifty-first year of Qianlong and joined the Huan River, the Wei River has been obstructed and breached year after year—because when they join they become harmful.
translations.idiomatic: He again went with Governor Cheng Zuluo to survey the upper reaches and proposed that since the Zhang had shifted south in Qianlong 51 and joined the Huan River, the Wei River had been obstructed and breached year after year—because when they joined they became harmful.

sentences.zh: 今漳水北徙，與洹水分流入衛，當因勢利導，各完堤防，使漳、洹不再合。」

translations.literal: Now that the Zhang has shifted north and enters the Wei separately from the Huan, we should guide them according to their courses, complete each embankment, and keep the Zhang and Huan from joining again."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Zhang had shifted north and entered the Wei separately from the Huan, they should guide them according to their courses, complete each embankment, and keep the Zhang and Huan from joining again.

sentences.zh: 疏上，詔從之。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, an edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 四年，予告回籍，食全俸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was granted leave to return to his native place with full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 4 (1824) he was granted leave to return to his native place with full salary.

sentences.zh: 先是建萬年吉地於寶華峪，均元相度選定。

translations.literal: Earlier the eternal auspicious burial site had been established at Baohuayu, and Junyuan had surveyed and selected the location.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the eternal auspicious burial site had been established at Baohuayu, and Junyuan had surveyed and selected the location.

sentences.zh: 帝敦崇儉樸，命偕莊親王綿課、協辦大學士英和監修，面戒規制一從節減。

translations.literal: The emperor upheld frugality and simplicity, ordered him together with Prince Zhuang Mianke and Associate Grand Secretary Ying He to supervise construction, and in person admonished that all regulations be reduced to the minimum.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor upheld frugality and simplicity, ordered him together with Prince Zhuang Mianke and Associate Grand Secretary Ying He to supervise construction, and in person admonished that all regulations be reduced to the minimum.

sentences.zh: 迨七年，孝穆皇后梓宮奉安，帝親視，嘉其工程堅固，晉均元太子太師。

translations.literal: By the seventh year, when the coffin of Empress Xiaomu was interred, the emperor inspected in person, praised the works as solid, and promoted Junyuan to Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: By Daoguang 7 (1827), when the coffin of Empress Xiaomu was interred, the emperor inspected in person, praised the works as solid, and promoted Junyuan to grand preceptor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 及是，地宮有浸水，上震怒，嚴譴在事諸臣，褫均元職，逮京治罪，擬重闢，念其耄老，免罪釋歸。

translations.literal: At this time water seeped into the underground palace; the emperor was enraged, sternly rebuked the officials involved, stripped Junyuan of office, had him brought to the capital for punishment, proposed heavy execution, but mindful of his great age, pardoned him and released him to return home.
translations.idiomatic: At this time water seeped into the underground palace; the emperor was enraged, sternly rebuked the officials involved, stripped Junyuan of office, had him brought to the capital for punishment, proposed heavy execution, but mindful of his great age, pardoned him and released him to return home.

sentences.zh: 均元歷官五十馀年，叔侄繼為樞相，家門鼎盛。

translations.literal: Junyuan served in office for more than fifty years; uncle and nephew in succession were Grand Council chancellors, and the family reached its zenith.
translations.idiomatic: Junyuan served in office for more than fifty years; uncle and nephew in succession were Grand Council chancellors, and the family reached its zenith.

sentences.zh: 自在翰林，數司文柄，及躋卿貳，典順天鄉試一，典會試三。

translations.literal: From his time in the Hanlin he repeatedly held literary authority; after rising to vice minister he presided once over the Shuntian provincial examination and three times over the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: From his time in the Hanlin he repeatedly held literary authority; after rising to vice minister he presided once over the Shuntian provincial examination and three times over the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 晚歲獲咎家居，世猶推為耆宿。

translations.literal: In his later years, after punishment he lived at home, yet the world still regarded him as an elder statesman.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years, after punishment he lived at home, yet the world still regarded him as an elder statesman.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒，年九十有五。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died at the age of ninety-five.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 20 (1840) he died at the age of ninety-five.

sentences.zh: 托津，字知亭，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，尚書博清額子。

translations.literal: Tuo Jin, courtesy name Zhiting, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the son of Minister Boqing'e.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Jin, whose courtesy name was Zhiting, belonged to the Fuca clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was the son of Minister Boqing'e.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，授都察院筆帖式，充軍機章京，累遷銀庫郎中。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign he was appointed copyist in the Censorate, served as Grand Council clerk, and was repeatedly promoted to director of the silver treasury.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he was appointed a censorate copyist, served on the Grand Council staff, and rose in succession to director of the silver treasury.

sentences.zh: 改御史，遷給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to censor and then to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor and then to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，命解餉銀赴達州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was ordered to transport pay silver to Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 (1796) he was ordered to transport pay silver to Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，授副都統，留治四川軍需。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Vice Commander-in-Chief and remained to manage Sichuan military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 (1800) he was appointed vice commander-in-chief and remained to manage Sichuan military supplies.

sentences.zh: 疏請軍餉先一月預撥，忤旨召回。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that military pay be disbursed one month in advance, offended the imperial will, and was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that military pay be disbursed one month in advance, offended the imperial will, and was recalled.

sentences.zh: 及至京，於餉數、軍事無所陳告，褫職，予頭等侍衛，充葉爾羌辦事大臣。

translations.literal: When he reached the capital he made no report on pay amounts or military affairs; he was dismissed from office, granted the rank of first-class imperial bodyguard, and appointed Commissioner at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the capital he made no report on pay amounts or military affairs; he was dismissed from office, granted the rank of first-class imperial bodyguard, and appointed commissioner at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 七年，調喀什噶爾參贊大臣，复授副都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Assistant Commissioner at Kashgar and again appointed Vice Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 (1802) he was transferred to assistant commissioner at Kashgar and again appointed vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八年，召為倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was summoned as Vice Minister of the Granary Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8 (1803) he was summoned as vice minister of the granary administration.

sentences.zh: 十年，調吏部，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and ordered to serve alongside Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10 (1805) he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and ordered to serve alongside Grand Council ministers.

sentences.zh: 偕直隸總督吳熊光往湖北，按訊鹽法道失察岸商抬價，及錢局鼓鑄偷減，治如律。

translations.literal: Together with Zhili Governor-General Wu Xiongguang he went to Hubei to investigate the salt commissioner for failing to detect shore merchants raising prices and the mint for secretly reducing coinage; both were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Zhili Governor-General Wu Xiongguang he went to Hubei to investigate the salt commissioner for failing to detect shore merchants raising prices and the mint for secretly reducing coinage; both were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 時總督百齡被訐在廣東索供應、造非刑，命托津偕總督瑚圖禮治其獄，請褫百齡職。

translations.literal: At that time Governor-General Bailing was impeached for demanding supplies and inventing illegal punishments in Guangdong; Tuo Jin was ordered with Governor Hutuoli to try the case and requested Bailing's dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Governor-General Bailing was impeached for demanding supplies and inventing illegal punishments in Guangdong; Tuo Jin was ordered with Governor Hutuoli to try the case and requested Bailing's dismissal.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調戶部，偕侍郎廣興按東河總督李亨特勒派廳員，奪亨特職，遣戍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue; together with Vice Minister Guangxing he investigated Eastern Rivers Governor-General Li Hente for forcibly assigning bureau staff, stripped Hente of office, and sent him into exile.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 11 (1806) he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue; together with Vice Minister Guangxing he investigated Eastern Rivers Governor-General Li Hente for forcibly assigning bureau staff, stripped Hente of office, and sent him into exile.

sentences.zh: 十二年，偕侍郎英和按訊熱河副都統慶杰貪婪，褫職遣戍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he went with Vice Minister Ying He to investigate Rehe Vice Commander-in-Chief Qingjie for greed; Qingjie was dismissed and sent into exile.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 12 (1807) he went with Vice Minister Ying He to investigate Rehe Vice Commander-in-Chief Qingjie for greed; Qingjie was dismissed and sent into exile.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕尚書吳璥勘南河。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went with Minister Wu Jing to survey the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13 (1808) he went with Minister Wu Jing to survey the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 先是，雲梯關外陳家浦漫決，由射陽湖旁趨海口，疆臣、河臣請改河道徑由射陽湖入海。

translations.literal: Earlier, outside Yunti Pass at Chenjiapu there had been an overflow breach trending toward the estuary beside Sheyang Lake; frontier and river officials requested changing the channel to enter the sea directly through Sheyang Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, outside Yunti Pass at Chenjiapu there had been an overflow breach trending toward the estuary beside Sheyang Lake; frontier and river officials had requested changing the channel to enter the sea directly through Sheyang Lake.

sentences.zh: 托津等疏言：「馬港口、張家莊漫水西漾數十里，始折歸北潮河。

translations.literal: Tuo Jin and others memorialized: "At Magangkou and Zhangjiazhuang overflow water spread west for several tens of li before turning back to the North Tidal River.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Jin and others memorialized that at Magangkou and Zhangjiazhuang overflow water spread west for several tens of li before turning back to the North Tidal River.

sentences.zh: 如果地勢建瓴，何以轉向西流？

translations.literal: If the terrain sloped steeply downward, how could it turn and flow west?
translations.idiomatic: If the terrain sloped steeply downward, how could it turn and flow west?

sentences.zh: 北潮河已匯流數月，水未消涸，顯見去路不暢，改道斷不可行。

translations.literal: The North Tidal River had collected flow for months without the water subsiding, clearly showing the outlet was blocked—changing the channel was absolutely unfeasible.
translations.idiomatic: The North Tidal River had collected flow for months without the water subsiding, clearly showing the outlet was blocked—changing the channel was absolutely unfeasible.

sentences.zh: 請仍修故道，接築雲梯關外大隄，收束水勢，較為得力。」

translations.literal: They requested restoring the old channel, joining and building the great embankment outside Yunti Pass to restrain the water's force, which would be more effective."
translations.idiomatic: They requested restoring the old channel and joining and building the great embankment outside Yunti Pass to restrain the water's force, which would be more effective.

sentences.zh: 又言：「河口高堰各工，因運河西岸堵築漫缺，頭、二壩口門較寬，不能擎托暢注，請速補築。」

translations.literal: They also stated: "At the estuary and Gaoyan works, because overflow breaches on the west bank of the canal were blocked up, the first and second dam gates were relatively wide and could not support and channel flow freely—rapid repair is requested."
translations.idiomatic: They also stated that at the estuary and Gaoyan works, because overflow breaches on the west bank of the canal were blocked up, the first and second dam gates were relatively wide and could not support and channel flow freely, and rapid repair was requested.

sentences.zh: 皆如所議行。

translations.literal: All was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All was carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，往江南讞獄。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he went to Jiangnan to try cases.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 14 (1809) he went to Jiangnan to try cases.

sentences.zh: 金山寺僧志學與王兆良爭墾沙地械鬥，斃多人，​​依律治罪。

translations.literal: The monk Zhixue of Jinshan Temple and Wang Zhaoliang fought over reclaimed tidal land with weapons, killing many; they were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Zhixue of Jinshan Temple and Wang Zhaoliang fought over reclaimed tidal land with weapons, killing many; they were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 請以蔣家沙洲歸公佃種，歲給寶晉書院及金山寺租銀各千兩。

translations.literal: It was requested that Jiangjia Sandbar be returned to public lease farming, with annual rent of one thousand taels each to Baojin Academy and Jinshan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: It was requested that Jiangjia Sandbar be returned to public lease farming, with annual rent of one thousand taels each to Baojin Academy and Jinshan Temple.

sentences.zh: 倉場書吏高添鳳舞弊，通州中、西二倉虧缺，命偕福慶勘訊，坐以姦吏骫法罪。

translations.literal: Granary clerk Gao Tianfeng committed fraud; the central and western granaries at Tongzhou showed deficits; Tuo Jin was ordered with Fu Qing to investigate and convict him of the crime of corrupt clerk violating law.
translations.idiomatic: When granary clerk Gao Tianfeng committed fraud and the central and western granaries at Tongzhou showed deficits, Tuo Jin was ordered with Fu Qing to investigate and convict him of corrupt clerk violating law.

sentences.zh: 既而，部鞫添鳳，復得私出黑檔領米狀，托津亦以久任倉場，譴責分賠。

translations.literal: Later, when the ministry tried Tianfeng, it was further found that he had privately issued black-ledger rice receipts; Tuo Jin, for having long served in the granary administration, was also rebuked and charged to share compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the ministry tried Tianfeng, it was further found that he had privately issued black-ledger rice receipts; Tuo Jin, for having long served in the granary administration, was also rebuked and charged to share compensation.

sentences.zh: 浙江學政劉鳳誥代辦鄉試監臨，有聯號弊，偕侍郎周兆基、少卿盧廕溥往按得實，論鳳誥遣戍。

translations.literal: Zhejiang Educational Commissioner Liu Fenggao, acting as supervisor of the provincial examination, was involved in linked-examination-number fraud; Tuo Jin went with Vice Minister Zhou Zhaoji and Junior Minister Lu Yinpu to investigate, found the charge true, and sentenced Fenggao to exile.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhejiang Educational Commissioner Liu Fenggao, acting as supervisor of the provincial examination, was involved in linked-examination-number fraud, Tuo Jin went with Vice Minister Zhou Zhaoji and Junior Minister Lu Yinpu to investigate, found the charge true, and sentenced Fenggao to exile.

sentences.zh: 山西署布政使劉大觀劾前任巡撫初彭齡任性乖張，偕侍郎穆克登額往按，彭齡，大觀俱被嚴議。

translations.literal: Acting Shanxi Provincial Administration Commissioner Liu Daguan impeached the former governor Chu Pengling for willful perversity; Tuo Jin went with Vice Minister Mukedeng'e to investigate; both Pengling and Daguan received severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When acting Shanxi provincial administration commissioner Liu Daguan impeached the former governor Chu Pengling for willful perversity, Tuo Jin went with Vice Minister Mukedeng'e to investigate; both Pengling and Daguan received severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢工部尚書，調戶部，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, and concurrently served as Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 15 (1810) he was promoted to minister of works, transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, and concurrently served as commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 偕盧廕溥往四川按事，總督勒保寢匿名揭帖，據實上聞，罷勒保大學士職。

translations.literal: He went with Lu Yinpu to Sichuan to investigate affairs; Governor-General Lebao had suppressed an anonymous denunciation; [Tuo Jin] reported the facts to the throne and Lebao was removed from his grand secretary post.
translations.idiomatic: He went with Lu Yinpu to Sichuan to investigate affairs; Governor-General Lebao had suppressed an anonymous denunciation; Tuo Jin reported the facts to the throne and Lebao was removed from his grand secretary post.

sentences.zh: 又偕府尹初彭齡往南河清查工帑。

translations.literal: He again went with Intendant Chu Pengling to the Southern Rivers to audit works funds.
translations.idiomatic: He again went with Intendant Chu Pengling to the Southern Rivers to audit works funds.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，兩江總督松筠調任，命托津暫代。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, when Liangjiang Governor-General Songyun was transferred, Tuo Jin was ordered to act temporarily in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Jiaqing 16 (1811), when Liangjiang Governor-General Songyun was transferred, Tuo Jin was ordered to act temporarily in his place.

sentences.zh: 尋回京，加太子少保，兼內大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he returned to the capital, was given the additional title of Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent, and concurrently served as Grand Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to the capital, received the additional title of junior guardian to the heir apparent, and concurrently served as grand minister of the imperial household.

sentences.zh: 十八年，扈蹕熱河，教匪林清逆黨闌入禁城，命托津回京察治。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he accompanied the court to Rehe; when sect rebel Lin Qing's faction broke into the Forbidden City, Tuo Jin was ordered to return to the capital to investigate and handle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 18 (1813) he accompanied the court to Rehe; when sect rebel Lin Qing's faction broke into the Forbidden City, Tuo Jin was ordered to return to the capital to investigate and handle the matter.

sentences.zh: 林清就獲，詔優獎，授協辦大學士。

translations.literal: When Lin Qing was captured, an edict granted exceptional commendation and appointed him Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Qing was captured, an edict granted exceptional commendation and appointed him associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 時匪黨李文成據河南滑縣，山東、直隸皆震動。

translations.literal: At that time rebel leader Li Wencheng held Huaxian in Henan, and Shandong and Zhili were both shaken.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rebel leader Li Wencheng held Huaxian in Henan, and Shandong and Zhili were both shaken.

sentences.zh: 那彥成督師，遷延未進，托津往代。

translations.literal: Nayancheng commanded the army but delayed without advancing; Tuo Jin was sent to replace him.
